question: Among our top 10 paying customers, can you identify the largest change in payment amounts from one month to the immediately following month? Specifically, please determine for which customer and during which month this maximum month-over-month difference occurred, and provide the difference rounded to two decimal places.
sql:
-- Final query with clean month format
WITH top10 AS (
    SELECT customer_id
    FROM payment
    GROUP BY customer_id
    ORDER BY SUM(amount) DESC
    LIMIT 10
),
monthly_payments AS (
    SELECT p.customer_id,
           date_trunc('month', p.payment_date) AS payment_month,
           SUM(p.amount) AS monthly_total
    FROM payment p
    WHERE p.customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM top10)
    GROUP BY p.customer_id, date_trunc('month', p.payment_date)
),
with_lag AS (
    SELECT customer_id,
           payment_month,
           monthly_total,
           LAG(monthly_total) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY payment_month) AS prev_month_total
    FROM monthly_payments
),
mom_diffs AS (
    SELECT customer_id,
           payment_month,
           ROUND(monthly_total - prev_month_total, 2) AS mom_diff
    FROM with_lag
    WHERE prev_month_total IS NOT NULL
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT c.customer_id,
           c.first_name || ' ' || c.last_name AS customer_name,
           payment_month,
           mom_diff,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY mom_diff DESC) AS rn
    FROM mom_diffs m
    JOIN customer c ON m.customer_id = c.customer_id
)
SELECT customer_id,
       customer_name,
       strftime('%Y-%m', payment_month) AS month,
       mom_diff
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
